approved_customer_facts.text: A Xero software licence is included in each Simbian monthly price. TaxSimba must confirm the exact licence, entitlements and commercial arrangements before treating any named Xero plan as guaranteed.

TaxSimba maintains clients’ digital bookkeeping records within defined limits for each MTD tier. The numerical limits are not yet approved or published — do not invent caps or promise unlimited bookkeeping.
Preparation and submission of the annual Self Assessment return are included in all three Simbian subscriptions, subject to an agreed scope and timely client records.
The £99 consultation is one 30-minute accountant-led Google Meet advice session. It does not include tax return filing, bookkeeping or a written report.
